claim_scope: Selected source-bound critical runtime paths and explicitly named unresolved handoffs only. This mechanism census includes nine narrowly scoped M3 controlled-test edges and otherwise M1/V0 evidence; it establishes conditional source reachability, not process activation, a completed operator workflow, production exercise, atomic post-COMMITTED lifecycle recording, external trust provisioning, integration quality, benchmark lift, GPQA or ARC-AGI capability, consciousness, AGI, or E5/E6.

definitions.static_import: A literal import observed in a source-bound file. It never establishes runtime reachability.
definitions.reachable_call: A call path confirmed by source control flow. It never establishes that a deployed process exercised the path.
definitions.exercised_trace: An immutable execution receipt bound to the exercised code and inputs. Test definitions and green console output alone are not traces.
definitions.authority: The source-attested scope allowed to affect a decision or side effect. An external-signature requirement is a mechanism claim, not proof that deployed trust provisioning exists.
definitions.unknown: The repository evidence inspected here cannot establish the claim. Unknown is preserved and never promoted from adjacent evidence.
